text:
sara: Quick sync — finalizing SEO tasks for the launch + webinar. Need short checklist and redirect patterns. Keeping this thread tight.

leo: list the high-risk legacy URLs and whether we should 301 or consolidate.

mika: dropping a tiny mapping sample to start; i'll add to the shared sheet after: 

old_path,new_target,redirect,reason,anchor_sample
/campaigns/spring22-bench,/blog/2026-inference-benchmarks,301,old campaign links,"LLM benchmarks"
/blog/bench-old-summary,/blog/2026-inference-benchmarks,302,short duplicate, "bench summary"
/webinar/signup-v1,/webinar/register,301,deprecated form,"register for webinar"
/docs/latency-old,/docs/latency,301,restructured docs,"latency comparison"

seo_ops: Note: preserve utm params when redirecting; use pattern rule: ^/campaigns/(.*)$ -> /blog/2026-inference-benchmarks 301, but whitelist /campaigns/partner-special. Also ensure redirects keep anchor fragments if possible.

infra-bot: Reminder: edge deployments blocked 22:30-01:30 PST. Schedule redirects to apply after 02:00.

sara: Schema checklist for pages:
- Blog (launch): Article + Dataset (for tables) + OG tags
- Webinar register: Event + FAQ (registration Qs) + VideoObject if we embed recording later
- Methodology appendix: HowTo or Dataset, internal links to benchmark summary

leo: Short content rules: if docs page <300 words and duplicates blog, merge into blog OR add rel=canonical pointing to blog. Avoid using canonical for short variants that could be merged.

mika: internal linking priorities: 1) /webinar/register from blog hero CTA, 2) benchmark summary -> methodology (in-text links), 3) product docs -> deep-dive anchors. Use descriptive anchor text where possible.

sara: I'll add a blog PR template checkbox set: meta title, meta description, canonical, schema snippet, OG/twitter, register CTA present, redirect entry in redirects.csv. Alex will review redirects.

infra-bot: Preview staging URLs: https://preview.redwood.ai/<pr>. Verify schema via view-source.

leo: I'll run a focused crawl and flag pages with >20 internal links; those get preserved anchor text in redirect mapping.

mika: Action: i'll upload redirects.csv by 15:00 and add sample nginx rules for the infra team.

sara: Great. Final timeline: redirects ready by 20:00, content freeze at 21:00, infra applies staged 301s after maintenance window. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
